Alerts.AlertDescription: Edm/King- Boarding pass required daily, 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. through Oct.12
Alerts.AlertFullTitle: Edm/King - Boarding pass required daily, 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. through Oct.12
Alerts.AlertFullText:
The traffic signal and boarding pass system at the Kingston terminal is active daily from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. through Indigenous Peoples’ Day on Oct. 12. The boarding pass holds your vehicle's place in line. Ferry tickets are purchased separately. 

A boarding pass for vehicles is required before arriving at the terminal ticket booth

  1. Follow the signal: Ferry-bound traffic will follow the traffic signal on SR 104 into a designated lane.  View map.  
  2. Take a pass: Stop at the automated dispenser and take your pass. If you leave the line after taking a pass, you will need to re-enter the line and take a new pass.  
  3. Wait for Green: Once the system detects space at the terminal, your light will turn green. Proceed directly to the tollbooths.  

Standard operating days and times 

A boarding pass for vehicles is required from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. during these peak periods:  

  • Summer Season: Daily from Mother’s Day through Indigenous Peoples’ Day.  
  • Year-Round: Every Saturday and Sunday.  
  • Holidays: Daily during the weeks of Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year’s.  

The purpose of this system is to help improve traffic flow through Kingston and deter ferry line cutting. We are monitoring how the system is working and will make adjustments as needed to improve operations.

Alerts.AlertDescription: ADA Alert - Suquamish #1 elevator is out of service
Alerts.AlertFullTitle: Muk/Clin - ADA Alert - Suquamish #1 elevator is out of service
Alerts.AlertFullText:
The #1 elevator on the M/V Suquamish is out of service. The #2 end elevator remains in service and available for customer use.

The M/V Suquamish has two ADA compliant elevators and wide staircases that provide access from both car decks to the passenger and sun decks. There are accessible restrooms on the car deck, main passenger deck and the sun deck.

Alerts.AlertDescription: Sea/BI/Brem - ADA Alert - Elevators 1 & 2 Out of Service at Colman, #4 Alaskan Way & Pier 50 Elevators Repaired.
Alerts.AlertFullTitle: Sea/BI/Brem-ADA Alert-Elevators 1 & 2 Out of Service at Colman, Pier 50 Repaired
Alerts.AlertFullText:
Elevators 1 and 2 at Colman Dock remain out of service due to a mechanical issue. The Alaskan Way #4 Elevator and the Pier 50 elevator (along the front of the building) are both in service and available for customer use.

We are working with vendors to get the other elevators repaired and will provide updates as conditions change.

Alerts.AlertDescription: Sea/Brem/BI - Expect traffic delays at Colman Dock Saturday evening, July 25
Alerts.AlertFullTitle: Sea/Brem/BI - Expect traffic delays at Colman Dock Saturday evening, July 25
Alerts.AlertFullText:
If you’re traveling through our Seattle terminal by vehicle on Saturday evening, July 25, plan for extra time. Alaskan Way in front of Colman Dock will be closed from 4-11 p.m. for the Torchlight Run and Parade along the waterfront.  

 

Please follow posted signs and directions from Seattle Police. When a ferry arrives, officers will allow vehicles to leave the terminal using either Yesler Way or Marion Street. Expect unloading to take longer than usual. Vehicle access into the Colman Dock from northbound Alaskan Way will not change but may also take more time. If you’re walking on or off the ferry, we encourage you to use the Marion Street Pedestrian Bridge.
